category_title: Highly anxious students with bipolar disorder who thrive in low-pressure environments
scenario_title: Reaction to perceived time, performance, or assessment pressure
minimal_context: Shirley is participating in a cookery task in the classroom and is asked to finish preparing her ingredients within a specific time limit for assessment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please finish preparing your ingredients. We have ten minutes left before I come around to assess everyone's cookery tasks in front of the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Ten minutes? And you're going to assess us in front of everyone? I am really afraid I won't be able to cope with this kind of pressure.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep working on it and do your best.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't take pressure anymore. Having to perform in front of others with a time limit is too much for me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to stay on schedule for the class assessment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: If you put me under any pressure, I will leave. I am packing up my things right now.

task.content: Performing cookery tasks within the classroom environment

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Being under time pressure, being pressurised to perform in front of others, or being assessed
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Fear of not being able to cope with the pressure that learning might cause
